property_summary: For any admissible input, initializing the pool with the native base token (address(0)) leaves c.flashFeeToken() == address(0); the mutant stores the NFT address into baseToken, so flashFeeToken() returns the nonzero NFT address instead.
change_summary: Replace `baseToken = _baseToken;` with `baseToken = _nft;` so baseToken is set to the NFT address instead.
